instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing circular sketch, defined by points at (-10, 0), (0, 8), and (10, 0), as the base profile. Create a 10 mm Part Design pad from the circle, then add a concentric circular pocket with radius of 4mm, cut 6 mm deep from the front face to the center of the cylindershape. Save the completed solid model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
